title: Agentic-Teacher: An Agentic Data Engine for Failure-Driven VLA Post-Training
description:
arXiv:2611.17394v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Improving a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) model requires demonstrations that address its weaknesses and provide effective supervision for learning. Coding agents can autonomously generate demonstrations through environment interaction, yet successful execution alone does not ensure effective supervision for VLA learning.
